name: Menu
author: omaxian
description: Opens the Omarchy menu (apps + commands); right-click is the command runner

schema.label: Icon glyph
schema.description: Single glyph shown on the bar. Default is the Archcraft cat (U+F011B). Must exist in the bar font unless iconFont is set.

schema.label: Icon font
schema.description: Optional font family for the glyph (e.g. a Nerd Font or omarchy). Leave empty to use the bar font.
